Class Logger

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Core.Logging
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Provides logging functionality with support for console and file output, log levels, and block logging.

Log(string, LogLevel)

Logs a message with the specified log level. If logging is disabled or the level is below the minimum, the message is not logged. The output destination depends on the configured OutputType.

public void Log(string message, LogLevel level = LogLevel.Info)

Parameters

message string

The message to log.

level LogLevel

The log level for the message. Defaults to Info.

LogFile(string, LogLevel)

Logs a message to the log file with the specified log level. If logging is disabled, the level is below the minimum, or the log file path is invalid, the message is not logged.

public void LogFile(string message, LogLevel level = LogLevel.Info)

Parameters

message string

The message to log to the file.

level LogLevel

The log level for the message. Defaults to Info.

LogFile(string, string, LogLevel)

Logs a message to the specified log file path with the given log level. If logging is disabled, the level is below the minimum, or the file path is invalid, the message is not logged.

public void LogFile(string message, string path, LogLevel level = LogLevel.Info)

Parameters

message string

The message to log to the file.

path string

The file path to write the log message to.

level LogLevel

The log level for the message. Defaults to Info.

StartLogBlock(string, LogLevel)

Starts a new log block with the specified title and log level. If a block is already active, it ends the current block before starting a new one.

public void StartLogBlock(string title, LogLevel level = LogLevel.Info)

Parameters

title string

The title of the log block.

level LogLevel

The log level for the block. Defaults to LogLevel.Info.
